Mentor application deadline May 5th

Apart Research & Atlas Computing are launching the Secure Program Synthesis Fellowship!

  • Please apply here to be a mentor till 5th May End of Day AoE: https://tally.so/r/gDNP2d
  • More info in the website of the fellowship: https://apartresearch.com/fellowships/the-secure-program-synthesis-fellowship
  • For questions please write us at: secure-program-synthesis-fellowship@apartresearch.com

There's a lot to do in spec elicitation and validation, adversarial robustness of proof tools, and spec driven development in general.

Additionally, there will be a hackathon May 22-24 on the same topics. We're expecting lots of projects to be Lean oriented in particular, especially with Signal Shot, Aeneas, and the SymM monad in the water lately.

Participant applications open https://apartresearch.com/fellowships/the-secure-program-synthesis-fellowship

14 mentors/streams! Especially relevant to the Lean community are the streams of: @Mike Dodds, @Shaowei Lin, @Kiran, @Luiza Cristina, Tomasz Nguyen, and Max von Hippel
